title: alchemilla hoppeana var. floribunda
intro: Alchemilla hoppeana var. floribunda, commonly known as lady's mantle, is a perennial herbaceous plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). It is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat a variety of health issues. The plant's leaves have been used to treat digestive issues and menstrual problems, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of Alchemilla hoppeana var. floribunda include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are thought to be responsible for the plant's therapeutic actions.
